cards.title: Pair of Stained Glass Panels with Male and Female Donor
cards.medium: pot metal, white glass with silver stain
cards.extract: The origin of these stained glass panels is unknown. They depict a male and female donor, presumably husband and wife, who gaze upon a now-lost central panel. The object of their devotions was likely a crucified Christ or a standing figure of the Virgin Mary. The man, dressed in armor, and the woman, wearing a bejeweled and richly embroidered gown, are accompanied by their not yet identified coats-of-arms. They are undoubtedly members of an aristocratic elite who commissioned these windows, perhaps for a family chapel.

cards.title: neri oxman’s material ecology imagines a future where buildings grow like living organisms
cards.extract: through two decades of research at the intersection of biology, computation, and fabrication, the designer proposes a new relationship between human invention and the intelligence of nature. cards.title: Strømsbu Sawmill / Henning Larsen
cards.extract: Henning Larsen and Ramboll have completed the transformation of the historic Strømsbu Sawmill in Arendal, Norway, into a new workplace for marine insurer Gard. Continuing the site's connection to maritime trade, the project brings together restored industrial buildings, spaces for collaboration, and a landscape designed to support local biodiversity.
